Residential Window Replacement and New Construction Installs At Colonial Building Supply, we offer professional window installation services throughout the Greater Salt Lake area and Northern Utah. Whether you’re remodeling a single room or replacing every window in the house, our experienced team provides fast, clean, and reliable installation. We do not manufacture windows in-house, but we work closely with trusted brands like AMSCO Windows and Cascade Windows to deliver high-quality vinyl window solutions for residential projects. Request a Free Measurement and Estimate — Contact Us Today Window Installation Services We specialize in residential window installations, including: Retrofit Window Replacement – Tear-outs and replacements for existing homes New Construction Windows – Installed prior to exterior finishing Single Window Replacements – No job is too small Custom Sizes – Tailored to fit your exact openings Glass-Only Reglazing – Save money by replacing the glass, not the entire frame We install windows in vinyl siding, brick, stucco, and more. If you’re dealing with a broken pane, foggy double-panes, or outdated glass, we can help. Quick Turnaround, Honest Service Our dedicated install team includes six full-time professionals operating from four trucks. On average, we install 10–15 windows per day, depending on the job size. For most homes, this means window replacement can be completed in as little as one day. We also: • Offer free on-site measurement and estimates • Provide clear, honest recommendations (we won’t sell you a new window if a reglaze is all you need) • Back our work with a 1-Year Labor Warranty • Install windows that carry a Limited Lifetime Manufacturer Warranty Transparent, Pressure-Free Pricing We keep our pricing simple and competitive. Most window installs fall within the $400–$600 range per window, depending on size and complexity. And unlike some national chains, we never pressure customers into full-home replacements just to justify the job. Have a single cracked window? We’ll measure, quote, and replace it—no upsell needed. Products We Trust We install and recommend: AMSCO Windows – Studio Series and Hampton Series vinyl windows Cascade Windows Both brands offer multiple tiers, frame styles, and energy efficiency ratings. We’ll help you select the right fit for your home and budget. See the Styles In Person Visit our Centerville showroom to view installed samples of single-hung, casement, sliding, and picture windows. Need more options? We can direct you to AMSCO’s full-scale showroom in Salt Lake City for expanded selection. Our Service Area Colonial Building Supply provides window installation throughout: Northern Utah: Davis County, Weber County, Salt Lake County, Morgan County, Summit County Extended Reach: Box Elder, Cache, Utah County, and surrounding areas (inquire for availability) Frequently Asked Questions Where can I find window installers near me in Utah We install throughout Davis, Weber, Salt Lake, Morgan, and Summit counties, with extended reach into Box Elder, Cache, and Utah County. How much does window installation or replacement cost in Utah Most installs run $400–$600 per window depending on size and complexity, with a free on-site measurement and no pressure to replace more than you need. Do you install windows for new construction, not just replacement Yes, we handle both retrofit replacement and new-construction installs, plus single-window jobs and glass-only reglazing. What window brands do you carry AMSCO Windows (Studio and Hampton series) and Cascade Windows, both vinyl. How quickly can I get a window installed or replaced Free estimates are scheduled within 1–2 business days, and most home installs are completed in as little as one day, backed by a 1-year labor warranty plus the manufacturer’s limited lifetime warranty. Schedule Your Free Estimate Fill out the form below and our window specialist will contact you within 1–2 business days to schedule a free onsite measurement. All inquiries are reviewed by our Window Installation Manager, Justin Henry.
